name: Silent Mansion [HORROR]
desc:
Silent Mansion is a cursed place, and you are the chosen one tasked with lifting the curse. Battle against the devil and spirits that haunt its halls to uncover the dark secrets and break the curse.

Headphones & max graphics recommended.
This game contains loud noises and jumpscares. 

Silent Mansion is currently in BETA. Follow for updates and release news.
